verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a browser-based chat app (chat.pipedream.com) and an 'MCP demo' link where developers can try out MCP tools before integrating into their own app, functioning as a playground. However, evidence doesn't describe a dedicated tool-by-tool inspector (e.g., viewing schemas, invoking arbitrary tool calls with parameter forms) — it's framed as a chat interface rather than a full inspector UI. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of an inspector-style UI for listing/testing individual tool schemas, independent hands-on confirmation of the playground's capabilities.
